name: The New York Times

fastest.text: Sign in at nytimes.com, open your Account, select Subscription Overview, then Cancel your Subscription.

steps: Sign in at nytimes.com and open your Account.
In the Manage Subscription section, select Cancel your Subscription.
Follow the instructions to finish. No cancel option? Call or chat with Customer Care (see below).
note: Billed through The Athletic? Cancel in your account settings for The Athletic instead.

faq.q: Can I cancel by phone or chat?
faq.a: Yes. In the US call 866-273-3612, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET on weekdays and 7 a.m. to 2 p.m. ET on weekends and holidays, or chat with Customer Care from the Times help center at the same hours.

faq.q: Why can't I cancel in my account?
faq.a: Only eligible digital and Home Delivery subscriptions billed by The Times can be cancelled online. For the rest, call or chat.
You go back to limited access to The Times's content.
